overview_description.description:
Little Thinking Minds is an educational technology company that creates educational products and resources among school aged children to improve learning outcomes, advance skills and increase cultural connectedness.

Initially the company started producing literacy content that addressed preschool basics focusing on early literary and numeracy. In 2015, capitalizing on their content expertise and wealth of lessons learnt interacting in the educational regional market they started developing online Arabic literacy solutions for schools, teachers and students. Their product, I Read Arabic, is the first and largest digital reading platform in the world. It provides children with a gamified journey containing hundreds of Arabic children’s books sourced from award-winning publishers in the region. KG Arabic introduces early learners to Arabic and enhances their vocabulary acquisition and fluency. Their latest platform I Start Arabic is designed for non-native speakers to learn the basics of the Arabic language and provides users with words and expressions that are necessary for everyday communication.

about_short_description.short_description: Little Thinking Minds is an award winning Edtech company that creates arabic educational platforms.

product.name: I Read Arabic
product.description: A digital literacy platform for native Arabic-speaking K-12 students offering leveled reading materials, interactive content, and assessments to develop reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills.

product.name: I Start Arabic
product.description: A digital program for non-native Arabic learners providing structured content and interactive activities to develop communication skills aligned with international language standards.

product.name: Arabic Benchmark Assessment
product.description: An assessment tool aligned with K-12 Arabic literacy frameworks that measures student proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking with detailed analytic reports for educators.

product.name: KG Arabic Program
product.description: A digital Arabic language learning program for early childhood focusing on phonetics and letter recognition aligned with national curricula.
